passages.context: CAL lines 20.14–29 were inspected in their full column context. The exact Aramaic transcription places Abram's petition, an afflicting spirit, failed healers, a request for prayer, restoration of Sarai, prayer, laying on of a hand, rebuke of the evil spirit, and recovery within one continuous retelling. This controls CAL's line sequence and readable lexical architecture, not a translation, manuscript-image collation, reconstructed lacunae, efficacy, representative practice, direct Gospel dependence, Christian ritual, diagnosis, or operational instruction.
